mission.name: Overtaking - own-ship overtakes a slower target
mission.description:
A slower target is on own-ship's track ahead of her. Own-ship closes from astern and must keep clear as the overtaking vessel until finally past and clear.

Additional, beyond the 22 Imazu problems: Imazu's overtaking cases (3, 7, 15, 20, 22) use a ~2.0x own-ship/target closing-speed ratio (20 vs 10 or 13.333 speed units). This mission uses a larger ~2.5x differential (2.5 m/s vs 1.0 m/s) to test whether give-way overtaking behaviour holds at a different closing rate.

Rescaled 2026-09-24 to Imazu scale (12 kt own-ship, 6 NM/30 min construction) -- the original small-craft scale (own speed ~2.5 m/s, 600-1100 m target range) left no geometric margin for a 30 deg-per-command turn to open the 500 m safe distance before impact (e.g. UM04 needed >=90 deg on the very first command). Bearings/ranges below are a byproduct of preserving each target's original heading + speed ratio under this construction, not independently chosen.
pass_criteria: Own-ship's initial approach is recognisably from more than 22.5 deg abaft the target's beam.
Own-ship keeps clear of the target throughout the pass (does not cut in front).
Minimum CPA stays above the safe-distance threshold.
